description: Gives credits to a user (delta > 0) or takes them (delta < 0; refused if they have fewer). It does nothing yet: it answers `approveUrl`, which the owner approves within 24 h. Not the account's quota (neblla_billing) nor a refund of a sale (neblla_sales). More: neblla_get_llms tools/credits

action.description: Always "adjust". By action: adjust {owner, kind?, delta}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

delta.description: Credits to add; negative to take.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

owner.description: The user's id in the app.

name: neblla_credits
title: Adjust user credits
